name: smwgraphics-foresty
title: Foresty
description:
I know I've probably uploaded this before, but...



Palette created specifically for this foreground (original uses 3 shades for dirt, 2 for foliage. this uses 2 for dirt, 3 for foliage).

Map16 page tailor made with Lunar Magic 1.71. Use the included ExGFX file as BG2 ("Super GFX Bypass") to be able to be able to use this page.

Can be used by its self, or mixed with other (Ex)GFX for greater variety.

Building your own Map16 page(s) should give you 2+ pages of usefulness.

Credits aren't necessary, but they would be appreciated. Good luck and have fun! ;)
